001package com.fs.starfarer.api.impl.campaign.ghosts.types;
002
003import java.util.Random;
004
005import org.lwjgl.util.vector.Vector2f;
006
007import com.fs.starfarer.api.Script;
008import com.fs.starfarer.api.campaign.CampaignFleetAPI;
009import com.fs.starfarer.api.impl.campaign.fleets.AutoDespawnScript;
010import com.fs.starfarer.api.impl.campaign.ghosts.BaseSensorGhost;
011import com.fs.starfarer.api.impl.campaign.ghosts.GBCircle;
012import com.fs.starfarer.api.impl.campaign.ghosts.GBIRunScript;
013import com.fs.starfarer.api.impl.campaign.ghosts.GBIntercept;
014import com.fs.starfarer.api.impl.campaign.ghosts.GBStayInPlace;
015import com.fs.starfarer.api.impl.campaign.ghosts.SensorGhostManager;
016import com.fs.starfarer.api.impl.campaign.ids.Factions;
017import com.fs.starfarer.api.impl.campaign.ids.FleetTypes;
018import com.fs.starfarer.api.impl.campaign.missions.FleetCreatorMission;
019import com.fs.starfarer.api.impl.campaign.missions.hub.HubMissionWithTriggers.FleetQuality;
020import com.fs.starfarer.api.impl.campaign.missions.hub.HubMissionWithTriggers.FleetSize;
021import com.fs.starfarer.api.impl.campaign.missions.hub.HubMissionWithTriggers.OfficerNum;
022import com.fs.starfarer.api.impl.campaign.missions.hub.HubMissionWithTriggers.OfficerQuality;
023import com.fs.starfarer.api.util.Misc;
024
025public class RemnantGhost extends BaseSensorGhost implements Script {
026
027        protected Random random;
028
029        public RemnantGhost(SensorGhostManager manager, CampaignFleetAPI fleet) {
030                super(manager, 0);
031                
032                random = Misc.getRandom(manager.getRandom().nextLong(), 5);
033
034                int maxBurn = 9 + random.nextInt(3);;
035                initEntity(genLargeSensorProfile(), genLargeRadius());
036                
037                if (!placeNearPlayer()) {
038                        setCreationFailed();
039                        return;
040                }
041                
042                setDespawnRange(-1000f);
043                
044                float speed = Misc.getSpeedForBurnLevel(maxBurn);
045                float accelMult = speed / Misc.getSpeedForBurnLevel(20f);
046                if (accelMult < 0.1f) accelMult = 0.1f;
047                setAccelMult(1f/ accelMult);
048                
049                addBehavior(new GBIntercept(fleet, 5f + random.nextFloat() * 2f, maxBurn, 450f, true));
050                addBehavior(new GBCircle(fleet, 0.7f + random.nextFloat() * 0.5f, maxBurn / 2, 300f, random.nextBoolean() ? 1f : -1f));
051                addBehavior(new GBStayInPlace(0.1f));
052                addInterrupt(new GBIRunScript(0f, this, true));
053                
054        }
055
056        public void run() {
057                FleetCreatorMission m = new FleetCreatorMission(random);
058                m.beginFleet();
059                
060                Vector2f loc = entity.getLocationInHyperspace();
061                
062                FleetSize size = FleetSize.MEDIUM;
063                FleetQuality quality = FleetQuality.VERY_LOW;
064                OfficerQuality oQuality = OfficerQuality.AI_MIXED;
065                OfficerNum oNum = OfficerNum.DEFAULT;
066                String type = FleetTypes.PATROL_MEDIUM;
067                float r = random.nextFloat();
068                if (r < 0.25f) {
069                        size = FleetSize.LARGE;
070                } else if (r < 0.5f) {
071                        size = FleetSize.LARGER;
072                }
073                
074                m.triggerCreateFleet(size, quality, Factions.REMNANTS, type, loc);
075                m.getPreviousCreateFleetAction().fQualityMod = -10f;
076                m.triggerSetFleetOfficers(oNum, oQuality);
077                m.triggerSetRemnantConfigDormant();
078                
079                CampaignFleetAPI fleet = m.createFleet();
080                if (fleet != null) {
081                        setVel(new Vector2f(0, 0));
082                        entity.getContainingLocation().addEntity(fleet);
083                        fleet.setLocation(entity.getLocation().x, entity.getLocation().y);
084                        fleet.addScript(new AutoDespawnScript(fleet));
085                        fleet.getMemoryWithoutUpdate().set("$fromGhost", true);
086                }
087        }
088        
089}
